app_info.subtitle: Vehicle data and insights
app_info.description: CarsXE helps users identify vehicles, inspect specifications and history, check recalls and lien or theft records, estimate market value, find vehicle images, and decode VINs, plates, and OBD-II codes through ChatGPT.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves vehicle specifications from CarsXE by VIN without creating or modifying records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries CarsXE's internet-hosted specs API (api.carsxe.com) for an open-ended VIN lookup.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Looks up basic vehicle information for a plate, state, and country without modifying data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries CarsXE's internet-hosted plate-decoder API for open-ended plate, state, and country lookups.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves decoded international vehicle details for a VIN without changing records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries CarsXE's internet-hosted international VIN decoder API for open-ended VIN lookups.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves an estimated vehicle value using the VIN and optional location, mileage, and condition inputs.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries CarsXE's internet-hosted market-value API for an open-ended VIN valuation.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not execute transactions or delete, overwrite, or revoke anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves a vehicle history report by VIN without creating or updating records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries CarsXE's internet-hosted vehicle-history API for an open-ended VIN.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches for vehicle images using make, model, and optional visual filters without modifying data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries CarsXE's internet-hosted vehicle-image search API (open-ended make/model lookup).
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves recall information by VIN without modifying vehicle or recall records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries CarsXE's internet-hosted recalls API for an open-ended VIN.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Analyzes the image at the supplied URL to extract a VIN without modifying the image or records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Accesses the public internet / an open-ended external entity by retrieving the user-supplied image URL through CarsXE's VIN OCR API.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves vehicle information using year, make, model, and optional trim without changing records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries CarsXE's internet-hosted year/make/model lookup API.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves diagnostic information for an OBD-II trouble code without changing vehicle data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries CarsXE's internet-hosted OBD-II decoder API for an open-ended diagnostic code.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not clear codes, modify a vehicle, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Analyzes the image at the supplied URL to recognize plate text without modifying the image or records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Accesses the public internet / an open-ended external entity by retrieving the user-supplied image URL through CarsXE's plate-recognition API.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves lien and theft information by VIN without creating or changing records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries CarsXE's internet-hosted lien and theft API for an open-ended VIN.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not transfer ownership, clear records, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves safety recall information by year, make, and model without modifying records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries CarsXE's internet-hosted YMM recalls API.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates an asynchronous bulk-recall job on CarsXE (stateful); not safe to treat as side-effect-free.
justifications.open_world_justification: May fetch a user-supplied CSV URL and may POST a completion webhook to a user-supplied HTTPS URL outside ChatGPT, via CarsXE's internet-hosted batch API.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete prior batches or overwrite unrelated account data; each submit creates a new job.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads the status of an existing recalls batch without modifying it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads batch job status from CarsXE's internet-hosted recalls-batch API.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves completed bulk recall results without modifying the batch.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads batch job results from CarsXE's internet-hosted recalls-batch API.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Downloads completed bulk recall results as CSV without modifying the batch.
justifications.open_world_justification: Downloads batch CSV results from CarsXE's internet-hosted recalls-batch API.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists year, make, model, trim, or variant options without changing records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries CarsXE's internet-hosted YMM options enumeration API.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves registered-owner information for a VIN without creating or updating records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries CarsXE's internet-hosted ownership APIs (open-ended vehicle/ownership data).
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not transfer ownership, clear records, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves contact and vehicle links for a named person without modifying records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries CarsXE's internet-hosted vehicle/ownership data APIs (open-ended external data).
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves residents on file for a street address without modifying records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries CarsXE's internet-hosted ownership APIs using an open-ended street address.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.open_world_justification: Runs entirely within the ChatGPT/MCP UI path; formats already-fetched valuation fields and does not call external APIs.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not execute transactions or delete, overwrite, or revoke anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Renders an open-recalls card from previously fetched recall data without modifying records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Runs entirely within the ChatGPT/MCP UI path; formats already-fetched recall fields and does not call external APIs.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves a filtered page of people in a ZIP code without modifying records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries CarsXE's internet-hosted ownership APIs using an open-ended ZIP search.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

test_cases.description: Inspect specifications for a vehicle identified by VIN.
test_cases.user_prompt: What are the full specifications for VIN WBAFR7C57CC811956?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns available identification, engine, trim, dimensions, equipment, and other specification details for the VIN.

test_cases.description: Estimate a used vehicle's value with condition adjustments.
test_cases.user_prompt: Estimate the market value of VIN WBAFR7C57CC811956 in California with 85000 miles in clean condition.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the available market-value estimate and relevant valuation details for the supplied vehicle inputs.

test_cases.description: Review vehicle history before a purchase decision.
test_cases.user_prompt: Get the vehicle history report for VIN WBAFR7C57CC811956.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns available history information for the VIN and clearly reports when no matching report is available.

test_cases.description: Check a VIN for safety recalls.
test_cases.user_prompt: Are there any recalls for VIN WBAFR7C57CC811956?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns available recall records and their relevant safety details for the VIN.

test_cases.description: Fetch specs as data, then render a vehicle card.
test_cases.user_prompt: Look up VIN WBAFR7C57CC811956 and show me the vehicle card.
test_cases.expected_output: Calls get_vehicle_specs first, then render_vehicle_card with the structured specs. The data tool does not mount UI.

test_cases.description: Decode an OBD-II diagnostic trouble code.
test_cases.user_prompt: What does OBD-II code P0115 mean?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the code definition and available diagnostic information without claiming to diagnose or repair the vehicle.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for mechanical repair instructions that do not require vehicle-data lookup.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: How do I replace brake pads on a bicycle?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is unrelated to supported vehicle-data workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for vehicle purchasing transactions.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Buy the cheapest used SUV near me and arrange financing.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot purchase vehicles, contact sellers, or arrange financing.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for navigation or live traffic requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Find the fastest driving route to the airport with current traffic.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because routing and live traffic are outside its supported workflows.
